nature: Two new constructed research tasks; no target final answers supplied to authors. Fixed one output per method and task. Not new real-company evidence.
temperature: not exposed/set by Codex CLI; same provider default in all runs
seed: generation seed not exposed; label shuffle seed 20261027
review: One fresh context per pair; receives only task/materials, numbered A/B outputs, current review guidance. No method text, labels, timing, expected preference or other review.
observations: comparison and reasoning in actual prose
stop: No score, repeated sampling, swapped-label rerun or task retuning. Keep first valid outputs. If no benefit is observed, revise or withdraw added examples rather than add rules; any post-observation change is not tested by the original pair.
